name: Summer Fun Junior Leader (Honolulu Parks and Recreation)
org: City and County of Honolulu Department of Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Teens help staff at Honolulu's city-run Summer Fun day camps for kids at parks across Oahu.
who_can_apply: Junior Leaders must be 13 before August 1 and no older than 17 by the camp end date (2026: July 24).
pay_detail: Pay not stated on the page. Paid summer aide jobs are listed separately (see the Summer Swim Aide card).
deadline_text: 2026 kid registration was May 11 to 15. Junior Leader sign up is through each site; 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Contact your local Summer Fun site (see the Summer Fun site map). Sign up as a Junior Leader.
notes: The page does not say whether junior leaders are paid or whether their hours count as volunteer service. Ask the site.
